scope: Native reconstruction of the commented Catalyst QSVT: six data bits, four exact phases, positive block controls, negative-zero reflection and big-endian modular shifts. Explicit ten-logical-wire correction and local CX/U3 pipeline. No unchanged foreign SDK execution, qjit/MLIR, source gate-set, optimizer or timing equivalence.
native_semantic_adaptations: The entire source is commented. It declares size+3 device wires but uses auxiliary wire size+3; native allocates size+4=ten logical wires and discloses this correction. Both block controls select one. Preserve the big-endian Adder word [data0,...,data5,deletion], negative-zero reflection and radian projector angles. Native packed arithmetic binds deletion as LSB followed by reversed data bit views. Explicit local eleven-physical/one-work/100000-operation/64MiB policy. Local exact CX/U3 conversion replaces the foreign CX/RZ/RY/RX plus qjit pipeline; reported counts are native target instructions, not MLIR CNOT counts or source basis parity. No foreign SDK runs.
